--- select_trailing_comma_subqueries.sql
(SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1,), ARRAY(SELECT 2,),)

                &ast.ExprSelectItem{
                  Expr: &ast.IntLiteral{
                    ValuePos: 40,

                    Base:     10,
                    Value:    "2",
                  },
                },
              },
            },
          },
        },
      },

  },
}
